channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Donatas Motiejunas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Donatas Motiejunas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Donatas Motiejunas
item.description:
With the Rockets' planned efforts to return forward/center Donatas Motiejunas to the roster at a standstill, Rockets general manager Daryl Morey said talks now involve the NBA in an indication that Motiejunas will not be signed to the contract the sides agreed to on Friday.

“We're in active discussions with Donatas' representation, the league office and that's pretty much it,”

Daryl Morey on Donatas Motiejunas, Dec 12, 2016. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Sean Marks on Donatas Motiejunas
item.description:
#Nets GMSean Marks on Motiejunas offer being matched:

“Its obviously disappointing when you miss out on a chance to acquire another asset. But at the same time it shows us we were going down the right path knowing...he was matched just like the guys it the past”

Sean Marks on Donatas Motiejunas, Dec 5, 2016. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Donatas Motiejunas
item.description:
#PistonsStan Van Gundy on Donatas Motiejunas trade veto:

“We did everything by the book and followed the process exactly the way it’s laid out to be followed.”

Stan Van Gundy on Donatas Motiejunas, Mar 9, 2016. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Donatas Motiejunas, Tobias Harris
item.description:
#PistonsStan Van Gundy:

“If you would have asked 2 weeks ago and said we had a chance to get either (Harris or Motiejunas), we would have laughed.”

Stan Van Gundy on Donatas Motiejunas, Tobias Harris, Feb 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.
